title: Cultural dates
intro: Suggested based on each of your countries. Add them as a Moment so they show up on your calendar.
noCountry.hint: Set your country in Settings to see more specific suggestions (only global ones are shown for now).
date.san-valentin.title: Valentine's Day
date.san-valentin.tagline: The day of love, in most of the world
date.san-valentin.message: Today the world celebrates what we celebrate every day.
date.flores-amarillas.title: Yellow Flowers Day
date.flores-amarillas.tagline: For you, all the yellow flowers
date.flores-amarillas.message: Today the world fills with yellow, and I just wanted to fill it with you.
date.amor-amistad-co.title: Love and Friendship Day
date.amor-amistad-co.tagline: The third Saturday of September, in Colombia
date.amor-amistad-co.message: Today we celebrate love and friendship, and you're both.
date.white-day.title: White Day
date.white-day.tagline: The day to return the affection, in Japan and Korea
date.white-day.message: A white gift for the one who gives me everything else.
date.tanabata.title: Tanabata
date.tanabata.message: Like the stars separated by the river of heaven, we always find our way back.
date.qixi.title: Qixi (Chinese Valentine's Day)
date.qixi.tagline: The seventh day of the seventh lunar month
date.qixi.message: Not even a river of stars could keep us apart.
date.dia-beso.title: International Kissing Day
date.dia-beso.message: Today we celebrate something we do every day.
date.dia-abrazo.title: International Hug Day
date.dia-abrazo.tagline: Nothing like a hug from you
date.dia-abrazo.message: Today the world celebrates hugs. We celebrate them always.
date.dia-namorados-br.title: Dia dos Namorados
date.dia-namorados-br.message: Today Brazil celebrates love its own way, and we celebrate ours.
date.pepero-day.title: Pepero Day
date.pepero-day.message: A day as sweet as you.
date.sweetest-day.title: Sweetest Day
date.sweetest-day.tagline: The third Saturday of October, in the US and Canada
date.sweetest-day.message: One small sweet gesture, just because.
